regions.original: 金原書店 小説・新刊・文庫
regions.translation: Kanahara Bookstore: Novels, New Releases, Paperbacks
regions.breakdown: 金原 (Kanahara) is a family name. 書店 (shoten) means bookstore. 小説 (shōsetsu) means novel. 新刊 (shinkan) means new publication/new release. 文庫 (bunko) refers to paperback books, often in a specific small format.
2F means 2nd Floor. 整体院 (seitai-in) is a clinic specializing in Seitai, a traditional Japanese manipulative therapy.

where_youd_see_it: On the front of a commercial building in a Japanese shopping area.
cultural_note: In Japan, 'bunko' (文庫) refers to a popular format of small, affordable paperback books, often released after the hardcover edition, covering a wide range of genres.
